releaseNotes: v1.2.1 -- Diagnostic logging fix. reolinkApiCall() previously logged every call as 'succeeded' whenever the HTTP request itself didn't error, even if the camera returned no usable value -- masking real issues on devices intermittently failing to return AI/motion state. Now logs the raw response body when a call gets an HTTP response but no usable value. No functional/behavior change, improves debug visibility only. Also includes v1.2.0 (PTZ calibration via calibratePtz/checkPtzCalibrationStatus, reorganized device page command grouping with model-dependent notes), v1.1.2 (debug logging for token lifecycle and poll transitions), and v1.1.1 (fixed a polling scheduler bug that could trip Hubitat's excessive-hub-load protection).
author: jdthomas24
